attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: food_label_ai_scanning
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "app_user"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_receive_image
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/camera/capture"
    output: raw_image

  - id: step_validate_image
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_image
      schema: image_format_size_schema
    output: validated_image

  - id: step_handle_image_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      step: step_validate_image
      action: notify_invalid_image

  - id: step_send_to_vision_api
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: validated_image
      url: "https://ai-vision.example.com/extract-nutrition"
      method: "POST"
    output: raw_ai_response

  - id: step_retry_vision
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step: step_send_to_vision_api
      retries: 3

  - id: step_extract_nutrition
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: raw_ai_response
      fields:
        - "calories"
        - "protein"
        - "carbohydrates"
        - "fat"
        - "serving_size"
    output: extracted_nutrition

  - id: step_validate_nutrition
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: extracted_nutrition
      schema: plausible_nutrition_schema
    output: validated_nutrition

  - id: step_check_plausibility
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "calories_per_serving <= 2000 AND protein >= 0 AND carbohydrates >= 0 AND fat >= 0"
      input: validated_nutrition
    output: plausibility_result

  - id: step_route_implausible
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "plausibility_result == false"
      target: step_flag_for_review

  - id: step_flag_for_review
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: validated_nutrition
      event: "implausible_nutrition_values_flagged"
      severity: "warning"
    output: flag_log

  - id: step_notify_review
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: validated_nutrition
      message: "Some extracted values seem implausible. Please review carefully before confirming."
      channel: "in_app"
    output: review_notification

  - id: step_format_form
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: validated_nutrition
      format: "food_entry_form_json"
    output: prepopulated_form

  - id: step_notify_user_confirmation
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: prepopulated_form
      message: "Please review and confirm your food log entry."
      channel: "in_app"
    output: confirmation_notification

  - id: step_wait_user_confirmation
    op: wait_for_condition
    params:
      condition: "user_confirmed == true"
      timeout: 300
    output: user_confirmation

  - id: step_route_on_confirmation
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "user_confirmation == true"
      target: step_write_food_log

  - id: step_write_food_log
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: prepopulated_form
      table: "food_log_entries"
    output: write_result

  - id: step_audit_entry
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: prepopulated_form
      event: "food_log_entry_created"
      severity: "info"
    output: audit_result

  - id: step_terminate
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
